extracted.intended_audience: prospective Guggenheim Fellowship applicants and the general public
extracted.subtask_description: Summary of eligibility, selection standards, application requirements, and program expectations for the John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation Fellowships. Useful for prospective applicants and those researching the fellowship's purpose and rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinguished past accomplishment and potential for future achievement
rubrics_metrics.description: Awards are bestowed upon individuals who have demonstrated distinguished accomplishment in the past and potential for future achievement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the core selection standard: evidence of a significant record of accomplishment plus indication the applicant will continue to produce important work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outstanding aptitude for prolific scholarship or exceptional talent in the arts
rubrics_metrics.description: The recipients exhibit outstanding aptitude for prolific scholarship or exceptional talent in the arts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection favors those showing either a strong scholarly publication record or exceptional artistic talent; applies across eligible fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field eligibility (natural sciences, social sciences, humanities, creative arts) and exclusion of performing arts
rubrics_metrics.description: The Foundation awards fellowships to professionals in the natural sciences, social sciences, humanities, and the creative arts, excluding the performing arts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although the performing arts are excluded generally, some related roles (see separate guidance) may still be eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exceptions within performing/creative fields (composers, film directors, choreographers eligible)
rubrics_metrics.description: The performing arts are excluded from these fellowships, but composers, film directors, and choreographers are still eligible to apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This clarifies that certain creative practitioners who might be thought 'performing artists' are nevertheless considered eligible; applicants should check discipline-specific eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic eligibility and separate competitions
rubrics_metrics.description: The foundation holds two separate competitions each year: one open to citizens and permanent residents of the United States and Canada, and the other to citizens and permanent residents of Latin America and the Caribbean.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note that the Latin America and Caribbean competition may be subject to suspension or changes (the page notes it was suspended while being reviewed); applicants must enter the correct regional competition based on citizenship/permanent residency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career-stage eligibility (students excluded; mid-career professionals encouraged)
rubrics_metrics.description: Students are not qualified to apply; advanced professionals in mid-career, such as published authors, are encouraged to do so.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The fellowship targets established professionals with significant prior work rather than early-career students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required application materials (references, CV, portfolio)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants are required to submit references as well as a CV and portfolio.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These materials form the evidentiary basis for evaluating past accomplishment and promise of future work; applicants should prepare strong references and a representative portfolio/CV.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant amount and duration tailored to individual needs
rubrics_metrics.description: The size of each grant varies and the amount and duration of the grant is adjusted based on the individual needs of the recipients, taking into consideration their other resources and the purpose and scope of their plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding is individualized: applicants should articulate project scope, timeline, and other resources so the Foundation can set an appropriate grant amount and duration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permitted use of funds (no prescribed restrictions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon receipt of the grant, Fellows are free to use the funds however they deem fit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The fellowship emphasizes freedom of time and opportunity rather than prescriptive spending rules; applicants can propose work assuming flexible use of funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program goal: provide dedicated time and relief from regular duties
rubrics_metrics.description: The goal of the grant is to provide recipients with dedicated time and freedom to pursue their projects or artistic endeavours, while being relieved of their regular duties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals and applications should emphasize how the fellowship would enable the applicant to advance work by providing time and removing other obligations.
